dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible perimeters of approximately 5-7 closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel-intensity gradients from high-intensity light grey perimeters to low-intensity dark grey interior voids.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of amorphous, high-intensity pixel clusters located on the posterior-lateral flank (far right), characterized by a lack of internal gradient and a stippled, mottled appearance.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-section form an irregular, non-equilateral quadrilateral with the longest axis oriented along the dorsal-ventral plane.
